About this Event

WE ARE BACK!!

CANDLELIGHT YIN YOGA, SOUND BATH + LIVE CELLOPresented by 

Join us for the Candlelight Kick-off with an evening of deep rest and soul-soothing sound at the Garden Pavilion in Saint John’s Resort.
Step inside a night made for relaxation.
From the moment you arrive, the Garden Pavilion glows with the flicker of hundreds of candles, bathing you in their warm golden light. Soft music and the scent of pure essential oils greet you, and a gentle hush invites your body to let it all go.

BEFORE THE PRACTICE
Begin your evening with a relaxation hour—enjoy the soothing heat of the mobile sauna and experience hand-crafted essential oil blends designed to deepen your sense of calm.
Let the day melt from your shoulders before you even step onto your mat.

THE EXPERIENCE
Once settled, a short guided breathwork session, led by Joy of , draws you inward as you move through an all-levels gentle yin yoga flow—slow, restorative poses that invite every muscle to soften and every thought to quiet.
As you rest in each pose, the rich resonance of the live cello blends with the ethereal tones of crystal singing bowls, wrapping you in a cozy cocoon of sound. Every note vibrates through your body releasing layers of tension and stress.
This is more than a class—it’s a ceremony of rest. A chance to reset your nervous system, ground your energy, and float into the week ahead with a profound sense of peace.

Included in the Evening - 
✨Gentle Yin Yoga
✨Live Cello
✨Sound Bath
✨Mobile Sauna
✨Essential Oil Bar

Reserve your mat now and gift yourself an unforgettable evening of pure relaxation.

For more information about other relaxation inspired events, visit aloe + alchemy.
